prompt.alinti: 8 free sites most editors have never heard of:
Not Pixabay. Not Pexels. Not Mixkit.
Museum art you can use in ads.
Layered waves, blob scenes, low poly grid.
Old ads, industrial films and home movies.
Find the name of any effect.

yontem.ne: Yıllık ücretsiz ses efektleri paketi (2015'ten beri).
yontem.alinti: a new bundle of pro sound effects every year since 2015, and the past ones are free too. 200GB+ in total, no credit needed.

yontem.ne: Film, grunge, kağıt, mührü ve lens efektleri için ücretsiz tekstürler.
yontem.alinti: film, grunge, paper, ink and lens textures. No signup, no credit.

yontem.ne: Google'ın animasyonlu emoji seti (GIF, WebP, Lottie).
yontem.alinti: Google’s emoji, animated, as GIF, WebP or Lottie. Free under CC BY 4.0, so credit Google.
1,440+ open source 3D icons. CC0, no credit.
492,000+ images of public domain art you can use anywhere, even in ads. Tick the Open Access filter when you search.

yontem.ne: 15 ücretsiz dalga, blob ve gradient arka plan generatorı.
yontem.alinti: 15 free generators for waves, blobs and gradient backgrounds. Fine for client work, no credit.

yontem.ne: Eski reklamlar, endüstriyel filmler ve ev filmleri (kamusal alan).
yontem.alinti: thousands of old ads, industrial films and home movies, free on the Internet Archive.

yontem.ne: 200+ görsel teknik ve örnekleri içeren referans sayfası.
yontem.alinti: 200+ visual techniques, each with examples. Spot an effect, find its name, learn it.
